description: One child request and an independent caregiver reply on the actual model. Child request is forced to exercise interaction; caregiver has two replies. Both dispositions use the fitted adult reference with explicit child extrapolation.

opportunities.situation: You are struggling with a school project. Maya is available to help. What will you do?

options.label: Ask Maya to work through the school project together.

contact_responses.label: Sit with Alex and work through the project together.
contact_responses.success_text: I asked Maya for help. Maya sat with me, listened, and we solved a difficult part together.
contact_responses.failure_text: I asked Maya for help. Maya sat with me and listened warmly, but we still could not solve the difficult part.
contact_responses.contact_text: Alex asked me for help. I sat with Alex, listened, and we worked through the project together.

contact_responses.label: Explain gently that you cannot help now and encourage Alex to try another approach.
contact_responses.success_text: Maya said gently that help was unavailable now, and I found a solution independently.
contact_responses.failure_text: I asked Maya for help. Maya said gently that help was unavailable now and encouraged me to try another approach. The difficult part remained unsolved.
contact_responses.contact_text: Alex asked for help. I explained gently that I could not help now and encouraged another approach.

options.contact_text: Alex asked me for help with a school project and we spent time on it together.
options.success_text: I asked Maya for help, and we worked out a difficult part of my school project.
options.failure_text: I asked Maya for help, and we tried together, but I was still stuck afterwards.
